Make Rot Flower cost something.

GMs: Slip a Rot Flower into combat when they're distracted; its DC 12 toxin will remind them why focus matters.

Daily tabletop RPG rulings. Follow @bizzalgames70 for one a day.

Hazards often trigger more than once - they apply effects each time conditions are met.

DMs: Clarify that hazards like burning trigger each time conditions are met, as per Rules Glossary, to avoid repeated disputes.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Vermin Blight changes the battlefield dynamics more than players expect - 200' + 10' per caster level range.

Judges: Use Vermin Blight's 200' + 10' per level range to force enemy movement, not just rack up damage.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Cloak Of Elvenkind's invisibility is more limited than players assume - it lasts only 5 rounds and ends if you.

GMs: Remind them the cloak's invisibility lasts 5 rounds; use it for stealthy retreats, not mid-battle vanishing acts.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Chuul: pick a cost, enforce it.

DMs: Mention the Chuul's DC 13 Constitution save for paralysis to remind players that melee range is a bad idea.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Lava Ooze Primeval Slime is more dangerous than it looks - camouflage grants +10 to stealth checks in volcanic.

Judges: Exploit its -3 initiative; let the players act first and leverage cold or water for double damage.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Birth Augur ties your Luck modifier to one roll type permanently - a d30 roll at creation sets the context.

Judges: Remind players their Birth Augur's Luck modifier affects one roll type permanently; it's not just a temporary Luck boost.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Disputes arise from unclear Difficulty Class - a clear DC list prevents them.

GMs: Stick to Easy DC 9, Normal DC 12, Hard DC 15, and Extreme DC 18 to avoid pointless arguments.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Centaur's mobility surprises players who underestimate its reach - double near movement enables rapid.

GMs: Exploit the centaur's double near movement to flank and disrupt the party's formation before they can react.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Interacting with Objects is deceptively simple - the action economy limits it to one free interaction per.

DMs: Remind players they get one free object interaction per turn; anything extra costs an action - no exceptions.

Warrior actions are more versatile than most realize - every attack can carry a free Mighty Deed if the action.

Judges: Remind your Warriors that every hit with a 3+ action die can trip or disarm without costing resources.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Fighter's early power spike catches many off guard - Weapon Mastery at level 1 gives access to all weapons.

GMs: Make sure Fighters exploit their Weapon Mastery at level 1 by equipping the heaviest Strength-based weapon available.
